newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - June 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arabs fear for peace process after U.S. House of Representatives passed a resolution recognising Jerusalem as Israel's united capital.
- Saudi Arabia has offered a $2.46 billion loan to the International Monetary Fund's recently set up international contingency fund known as the New Arrangements to Borrow (NAB) facility.
- Dubai plans market for used cars.
- Gulf supermarkets lack new promotion ideas.
- UAE court questions the accuracy of periodic bank statements.
- UAE maintains human growth levels - UNDP report.
